The platform can only show a bare link

How Open Graph fields affect a preview

Four basic outputs should map cleanly: og:title, og:description, og:image, and og:url provide the title, description, image, and address. The image must be readable from a public URL by the sharing platform, not only on a local machine or behind a login.

The platform may keep an old fetch: After changing fields, request or refresh the platform preview and inspect the real card. Correct page source proves the fields were emitted, not that a cached preview has updated.

It is not SEO or a page image

Open Graph focuses on external link previews; SEO is the broader search-presentation topic; an Image is the image shown in a page or asset. A working Hero image does not prove that og:image is correct.
